lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Company. Two o'clock-ish.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Contact. Ahead.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Is that... no. Yeah. It's moving.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Movement. Stay together.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Reloading! Don't let it near me!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Changing mags, give me a second!

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Reloading.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Loading. Cover me.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Stay down this time. Please.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: That one's done. I think. Is it done?

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Down.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: It's not moving. Good.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Legs! That's the trick!

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Good. It can't follow us now.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Ugh. That came off. That came right off.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Legs, Jay! Take its legs!

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: The body isn't stopping it. Legs.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Hold still, Jay. I have it.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Get off him! Get off!

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Push it back. Now.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hngh!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hh-!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: You good? You're good.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: You're clear. Breathe.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Jay's down. I'm coming.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Stay with me, Jay. Ten seconds.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: You're up. Don't make me do that again.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Back on your feet. Slowly.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Tomas is down! Jay, cover him!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Doc's down! Doc's down!

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Giles is down. Keep them off him.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Stay down, August. I'm coming.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Ow. Okay. Okay, I'm up.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: I'm up. Watch the left.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: You're running light, Jay. Counting your shots?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: How many rounds have you got left? Because I'm guessing not many.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: You're bleeding, Jay. Find a medkit.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: That's too much blood. Patch up when you can.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Clear.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Is that all of them? Tell me that's all of them.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Clear for now. Reload while you can.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Come on, sweetheart. Open up.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Halfway there. This panel hates me.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Hear that hum? That's a happy station. Mostly.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Drink some water, Jay. The recyclers dry you out.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Four hundred metres of ocean on the roof. Don't think about it.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: That's your third coffee today. I'm noting it.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Didn't the botanists want their irrigation log signed? Hydroponics is the green glow, right?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Smell that? Wet soil. Isn't hydroponics this way somewhere?

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: The irrigation log is in hydroponics. The botanists keep it at their station.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Hydroponics is still on your list. The log needs your signature.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Want a hand? I've put hydroponics on your visor. See it?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Doesn't the dive crew have a sample case waiting on us?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Where did they say the dive bay was? Somewhere wet, I'd bet.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: The sample case goes to the airlock locker in the dive bay.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: The divers are waiting on that case, Jay. Dive bay.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Lost? Happens to me daily. I've marked the dive bay on your visor, see?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Didn't Hale say he had a card for you? Where do the carpet people live?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: When did you last see carpet down here? The admin office, maybe?

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Hale has your Level 2 Card. His office is in the admin wing.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: The admin office is the one with the plants and the glass walls.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Want the short way? Hale's office is on your visor now. Go on.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: That storeroom needs Level 2. Hale is issuing your card today.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Isn't there usually a wall map near the entrance of each section?

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Every section has a wall map. Download it and the whole area fills in.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: The way out is behind us. Keep moving, Jay.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: The door's that way, isn't it? Can we be through it? Now?
